name: sqlc-ts
description: Typed TypeScript query functions from sqlc's JSON analysis

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && for d in postgres sqlite; do cp src/dialects/$d/runtime.ts dist/dialects/$d/; done
scripts.fixture: for d in postgres sqlite; do (cd test/fixture/$d && sqlc generate && node ../../../src/cli.ts codegen_request.json gen) || exit 1; done
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
